_file: ~/.gemini/settings.json · or .gemini/settings.json in a project · or one command: gemini mcp add --transport http dchub https://dchub.cloud/mcp
_note: The field is `httpUrl`. `url` is the SSE form — a Streamable-HTTP server under `url` is dialled with the wrong transport and never connects. The consumer Gemini app has no custom-MCP field at all.
